description: Hey, I’m Surya! I work with Python, ML, CAD/3D engineering, and simulations, and I love building real, working space tools. I’m planning to tackle Lunar Landing Site Navigator and I’ll handle the engineering, NASA data processing, and backend logic. Looking for 1–2 teammates into frontend/UI, 3D/data viz, or video/storytelling so we can ship a standout working prototype in 39 hours. Feel free to reach out!
